title: mentha pagana
intro: Mentha pagana, commonly known as American peppermint or bog mint, is a perennial plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include alleviating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as a natural remedy for headaches and nausea. The therapeutic actions of Mentha pagana include its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as menthol, menthone, and limonene. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's ability to relieve pain, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
